name: treant-c
description: a walking tree creature made wholly of living oak wood: its body and head one broad old oak trunk, its bark thick and deeply furrowed in deep vertical ridges and cracks, weathered grey-brown with near-black furrows and lighter worn ridges; a gnarled face grown in the upper front of the trunk, deep dark eye hollows under a heavy knotted brow and a wide split for a mouth; two long thick knotted branch arms ending in five twig-like fingers; two stout root legs with splayed root feet; a small sparse crown of a few short leafy oak twigs on top of its head; a few patches of green moss on the shoulders
